E131.before:
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAL HASANI WAL HUSAYN
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
عَبْدَيْكَ وَوَلِيَّيْكَ
A'BDAYKA WA WALIYYAYK
Your two servants and friends,
وَٱبْنَيْ رَسُولِكَ وَسِبْطَيِ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ
WABNAY RASOOLIKA WA SIBTAYIR RAHMAH
the two sons of Your Messenger, the two grandsons of Mercy,
وَسَيِّدَيْ شَبَابِ أَهْلِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ
WA SAYYIDAY SHABAABI AHLIL JANNAH
and the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise,
أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلاَدِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ وَٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
AFDALA MAA SALLAYTA A'LAA AHADIN MIN AWLAADIN NABIYYEENA WAL MURSALEEN
with the most excellent blessings that You have ever sent upon any of the sons of the Prophets and the Messengers.
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱبْنِ سَيِّدِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAL HASANIBNI SAYYIDIN NABIYYEEN
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan the son of the chief of the Prophets
وَوَصِيِّ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
WA WASIYYI AMEERIL MU'MINEEN
and the successor of the Commander of the Faithful.
اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA YABNA RASOOLILLAAH
Peace be upon you, O son of Allah's Messenger.
اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA YABNA SAYYIDIL WASIYYEEN
Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.
أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ASH-HADU ANNAKA YABNA AMEERIL MU'MINEEN
I bear witness that you are verily the son of the Commander of the Faithful,
أَمِينُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنُ أَمِينِهِ
AMEENULLAAHI WABNU AMEENIH
the trustee of Allah, and the son of His trustee.
عِشْتَ رَشِيداً مَظْلُوماً
I'SHTA RASHEEDAN MAZLOOMAA
You lived upright and persecuted
وَمَضَيْتَ شَهِيداً
WA MADAYTA SHAHEEDAA
and passed away as martyr.
وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ ٱلإِمَامُ ٱلزَّكِيُّ
WA ASH-HADU ANNAKAL IMAAMUZ ZAKIYY
And I bear witness that you are verily the pure,
ٱلْهَادِي ٱلْمَهْدِيُّ
AL-HAADIL MAHDIYY
guiding, and well-guided leader.
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ
ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAYH
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon him
وَبَلِّغْ رُوحَهُ وَجَسَدَهُ عَنِّي
WA BALLIGH ROOHAHOO WA JASADAHOO A'NNEE
and convey to his soul and body
فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَفْضَلَ ٱلتَّحِيَّةِ وَٱلسَّلاَمِ
FEE HAADHIHIS SAA'ATI AFDALAT TAHIYYATI WAS SALAAM
at this hour the best greeting and salutation from me.
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAL HUSAYNIBNI A'LIYY
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Husayn the son of 'Ali,
ٱلْمَظْلُومِ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
AL-MAZLOOMISH SHAHEED
the oppressed, the martyr,
قَتِيلِ ٱلْكَفَرَةِ وَطَرِيحِ ٱلْفَجَرَةِ
QATEELIL KAFARATI WA TAREEHIL FAJARAH
the slain by the unbelievers, and the thrown down by the sinful people.
اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA ABAA A'BDILLAAH
Peace be upon you, O Abu-'Abdullah.
اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA YABNA RASOOLILLAAH
Peace be upon you, O son of Allah's Messenger.
اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA YABNA AMEERIL MU'MINEEN
Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.
أَشْهَدُ مُوقِناً أَنَّكَ أَمِينُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنُ أَمِينِهِ
ASH-HADU MOOQINAN ANNAKA AMEENULLAAHI WABNU AMEENIH
I bear witness with full conviction that you are verily the trustee of Allah and the son of His trustee.
قُتِلْتَ مَظْلُوماً وَمَضَيْتَ شَهِيداً
QUTILTA MAZLOOMAN WA MADAYTA SHAHEEDAA
You were killed wrongly and you passed away as martyr.
وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَعَالَىٰ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِثَأْرِكَ
WA ASH-HADU ANNALLAAHA TA'AALAT TAALIBU BITHA'RIK
I also bear witness that Allah the All-exalted is the One Who shall avenge You
وَمُنْجِزٌ مَا وَعَدَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّصْرِ وَٱلتَّأْيِيدِ
WA MUNJIZUN MAA WA-A'DAKA MINAN NASRI WAT TA'YEED
and shall fulfill His promise to You of support and victory
فِي هَلاَكِ عَدُوِّكَ وَإِظْهَارِ دَعْوَتِكَ
FEE HALAAKI A'DUWWIKA WA IZHAARI DA'WATIK
through exterminating your enemies and demonstrating your call (to the true guidance).
وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ وَفَيْتَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ
WA ASH-HADU ANNAKA WAFAYTA BI-A'HDILLAAH
I also bear witness that you fulfilled your covenant with Allah,
وَجَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
WA JAAHADTA FEE SABEELILLAAH
strove hard for His sake,
وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
WA A'BADTALLAAHA MUKHLISAN HATTAA ATAAKAL YAQEEN
and served Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكَ
LA-A'NALLAAHU UMMATAN QATALATK
May Allah curse the people who killed you.
وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً خَذَلَتْكَ
WA LA-A'NALLAAHU UMMATAN KHADHALATK
May Allah curse the people who disappointed you.
وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً أَلَّبَتْ عَلَيْكَ
WA LA-A'NALLAAHU UMMATAN ALLABAT A'LAYK
May Allah curse the people who incited people against you.
وَأَبْرَأُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ مَمَّنْ كَذَّبَكَ
WA ABRA'U ILALLAAHI TA'AALAA MIMMAN AKDHABAK
I release myself before Allah the All-exalted from those who belied you,
وَٱسْتَخَفَّ بِحَقِّكَ وَٱسْتَحَلَّ دَمَكَ
WASTAKHAFFA BIHAQQIKA WASTAHALLA DAMAK
belittled your right, and allowed themselves to shed your blood.
بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
BI-ABEE ANTA WA UMMEE YAA ABAA A'BDILLAAH
May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ قَاتِلَكَ
LA-A'NALLAAHU QAATILAK
Allah's curse be on those who killed you.
وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ خَاذِلَكَ
WA LA-A'NALLAAHU KHAADHILAK
Allah's curse be on those who let you down.
وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ سَمِعَ وَاعِيَتَكَ فَلَمْ يُجِبْكَ وَلَمْ يَنْصُرْكَ
WA LA-A'NALLAAHU MAN SAMI'A WAA'IYATAKA FALAM YUJIBKA WA LAM YANSURK
Allah's curse be on those who heard your call (for help), but they refrained from responding to you or supporting you.
وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ سَبَىٰ نِسَاءَكَ
WA LA-A'NALLAAHU MAN SABAA NISAA'AK
Allah's curse be on those who captured your women.
أَنَا إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ بَرِيءٌ وَمِمَّنْ وَالاَهُمْ
ANAA ILALLAAHI MINHUM BAREE'UN WA MIMMAN WAALAAHUM
I disavow them all before Allah and disavow those who adhered to them,
وَمَالَاَهُمْ وَأَعَانَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ
WA MAALA'AHUM WA A'AANAHUM A'LAYH
those who kept up with them, and those who helped them against you.
وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ وَٱلأَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
WA ASH-HADU ANNAKA WAL A'IMMATA MIN WULDIKA KALIMATUT TAQWAA
I also bear witness that you and the Imams from your descendants are the word of piety,
وَبَابُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَٱلْعُرْوَةُ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ
WA BAABUL HUDAA WAL U'RWATUL WUTHQAA
the door to true guidance, the firmest handle,
وَٱلْحُجَّةُ عَلَىٰ أَهْلِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
WAL HUJJATU A'LAA AHLID DUNYAA
and the argument against the inhabitants of this world.
وَأَشْهَدُ أَنِّي بِكُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ
WA ASH-HADU ANNEE BIKUM MU'MIN
I also bear witness that I have full faith in you,
وَبِمَنْزِلَتِكُمْ مُوقِنٌ
WA BIMANZILATIKUM MOOQIN
I have conviction in your standing,
وَلَكُمْ تَابِعٌ بِذَاتِ نَفْسِي
WA LAKUM TAABI'UN BIDHAATI NAFSEE
and I always follow you in myself,
وَشَرَائِعِ دِينِي وَخَوَاتِيمِ عَمَلِي
WA SHARAA'I'I DEENEE WA KHAWAATEEMI A'MALEE
in the laws of my religion, in my sealing deeds,
وَمُنْقَلَبِي فِي دُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي
WA MUNQALABEE FEE DUNYAAYA WA AAKHIRATEE
in my tour, and in my settlement in this worldly life and the Hereafter.

اَنَا اِلَىٰ اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ بَرِيءٌ وَمِمَّنْ وَالَاهُمْ
ANAA ILALLAAHI MINHUM BAREE'UN WA MIMMAN WAALAAHUM
I disavow them all before Allah and disavow those who adhered to them,
وَمَالَاَهُمْ وَاَعَانَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ
WA MAALA'AHUM WA A'AANAHUM A'LAYH
those who kept up with them, and those who helped them against you.
وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ وَالَائِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ التَّقْوَىٰ
WA ASH-HADU ANNAKA WAL A'IMMATA MIN WULDIKA KALIMATUT TAQWAA
I also bear witness that you and the Imams from your descendants are the word of piety,
وَبَابُ الْهُدَىٰ وَالْعُرْوَةُ الْوُثْقَىٰ
WA BAABUL HUDAA WAL U'RWATUL WUTHQAA
the door to true guidance, the firmest handle,
وَالْحُجَّةُ عَلَىٰ اَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا
WAL HUJJATU A'LAA AHLID DUNYAA
and the argument against the inhabitants of this world.
وَاَشْهَدُ اَنِّي بِكُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ
WA ASH-HADU ANNEE BIKUM MU'MIN
I also bear witness that I have full faith in you,
وَبِمَنْزِلَتِكُمْ مُوقِنٌ
WA BIMANZILATIKUM MOOQIN
I have conviction in your standing,
وَلَكُمْ تَابِعٌ بِذَاتِ نَفْسِي
WA LAKUM TAABI'UN BIDHAATI NAFSEE
and I always follow you in myself,
وَشَرَائِعِ دِينِي وَخَوَاتِيمِ عَمَلِي
WA SHARAA'I'I DEENEE WA KHAWAATEEMI A'MALEE
in the laws of my religion, in my sealing deeds,
وَمُنْقَلَبِي فِي دُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي
WA MUNQALABEE FEE DUNYAAYA WA AAKHIRATEE
in my tour, and in my settlement in this worldly life and the Hereafter.

E134.before:
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلصَّادِقِ
ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA JA'FARIBNI MUHAMMADINIS SAADIQ
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Ja'far the son of Muhammad the veracious,
خَازِنِ ٱلْعِلْمِ
KHAAZINIL I'LM
the treasure of knowledge,
ٱلدَّاعِي إِلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ
AD-DAA'EE ILAYKA BIL HAQQ
the caller to You with the truth,
ٱلنُّورِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
AN-NOORIL MUBEEN
and the manifest light.
اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا جَعَلْتَهُ مَعْدِنَ كَلاَمِكَ وَوَحْيِكَ
ALLAAHUMMA WA KAMAA JA'ALTAHOO MA'DINA KALAAMIKA WA WAHYIK
O Allah, as You have made him the core of Your words and revelations,
وَخَازِنَ عِلْمِكَ
WA KHAAZINA I'LMIK
the treasure of Your knowledge,
وَلِسَانَ تَوْحِيدِكَ
WA LISAANA TAWHEEDIK
the spokesman of the profession of Your Oneness,
وَوَلِيَّ أَمْرِكَ
WA WALIYYA AMRIK
the authorized to undertake Your mission,
وَمُسْتَحْفَظَ دِينِكَ
WA MUSTAHFAZA DEENIK
and the keeper of Your religion,
فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ
FASALLI A'LAYH
so also (please) send blessings upon him
أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ
AFDALA MAA SALLAYTA A'LAA AHAD
with the most excellent blessings that You have ever sent upon any
مِنْ أَصْفِيَائِكَ وَحُجَجِكَ
MIN ASFIYAA'IKA WA HUJAJIK
of Your elite people and arguments.
إنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
INNAKA HAMEEDUM MAJEED
Verily, You are full of praise, full of glory.

E136.before:
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ
ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA A'LIYYIBNI MOOSAA
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon 'Ali the son of Musa
ٱلَّذِي ٱرْتَضَيْتَهُ وَرَضَّيْتَ بِهِ مَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
ALLADHIR TADAYTAHOO WA RADDAYTA BIHEE MAN SHI'TA MIN KHALQIK
whom You have accepted and through whom You have satisfied whomever of Your creatures that You wish.
اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا جَعَلْتَهُ حُجَّةً عَلَىٰ خَلْقِكَ
ALLAAHUMMA WA KAMAA JA'ALTAHOO HUJJATAN A'LAA KHALQIK
O Allah, as You have made him act as argument against Your creatures,
وَقَائِماً بِأَمْرِكَ
WA QAA'IMAN BI-AMRIK
undertake the mission by Your command,
وَنَاصِراً لِدِينِكَ
WA NAASIRAN LIDEENIK
support Your religion,
وَشَاهِداً عَلَىٰ عِبَادِكَ
WA SHAAHIDAN A'LAA I'BAADIK
witness against Your servants,
وَكَمَا نَصَحَ لَهُمْ فِي ٱلسِّرِ وَٱلْعَلاَنِيَةِ
WA KAMAA NASAHA LAHUM FIS SIRRI WAL A'LAANIYAH
and as he acted sincerely towards them in secret and in open
وَدَعَا إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِكَ
WA DA-A'AA ILAA SABEELIK
and called to Your way
بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ
BIL HIKMATI WAL MAW'IZATIL HASANAH
with wisdom and excellent exhortation,
فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ
FASALLI A'LAYH
so also (please) bless him
أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ
AFDALA MAA SALLAYTA A'LAA AHAD
with the most favorite blessings that You have ever bestowed
مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ وَخِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
MIN AWLIYAA'IKA WA KHIYARATIKA MIN KHALQIK
upon any of Your intimate servants and Your choice ones over Your creatures.
إِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيمٌ
INNAKA JAWAADUN KAREEM
Verily, You are All-magnanimous, All-generous.
